resources.li_text.15_000_documentary_sty: $15,000+: Documentary-style production (think "the kind of wedding video that wins Vimeo Staff Picks"). Real cinematic production. Worth it if you're making a film, not just a record.
resources.li_text.16mm_silent_era_throug: 16mm (silent era through 1980s): Recoverable with caveats. Higher resolution than 8mm, so more detail to work with. Slightly less color fading.
resources.li_text.1_500_3_000_two_videog: $1,500-$3,000: Two videographers, 8-10 hours, highlight reel (3-7 min) + full ceremony. The most common "mid-tier" range. Solid quality, no surprises.
resources.li_text.3_000_6_000_two_videog: $3,000-$6,000: Two videographers + audio tech, 10-12 hours, cinematic trailer (1-3 min) + full documentary edit, drone footage, multiple cameras. This is "real professional."
resources.li_text.500_1_500_single_video: $500-$1,500: Single videographer, 6-8 hours, documentary edit, 30-60 day delivery. Entry-level. Usually a solo operator with a consumer camera and basic editing software.
resources.li_text.6_000_15_000_full_prod: $6,000-$15,000: Full production team, multiple cameras, custom color grading, licensed music, same-day edit teaser, drone. Luxury tier. Worth it for high-budget weddings.
8mm / Super 8 (1965-1990): Recoverable but trickier. The film itself is degrading. Color fades to magenta over time. We digitize, then AI color-restore.
resources.li_text.all_inclusive_package_: "All-inclusive package" — usually means everything is basic. Ask for line items.
resources.li_text.archive_quality_4k_out: Archive-quality (4K output, colorist, audio engineer): $800-$1,500 per tape. For irreplaceable footage only.
resources.li_text.audio_quality_if_you_c: Audio quality. If you can't hear the vows over wind noise, they'll butcher your vows too.
resources.li_text.audio_restoration.3779: Audio restoration. AI denoising + EQ + spectral repair (for specific clicks and pops). We don't overdo this — old audio has character.
resources.li_text.betamax_1975_1985.9088: Betamax (1975-1985): Mostly recoverable. Similar to VHS but with mechanical issues that need professional handling.
resources.li_text.build_a_family_memoria: Build a family memorial video for future anniversaries. If you have old footage (your parents' wedding, your grandparents' wedding), weave it together with yours. Your 25th anniversary video becomes a 50-year story.
resources.li_text.can_i_see_a_full_weddi: "Can I see a full wedding film from someone with my venue type?" — Outdoor vs indoor lighting is a huge difference.
resources.li_text.cinematic_trailer_1_3_: Cinematic trailer (1-3 minutes): Hollywood-style teaser, slow motion, color grading. This is what most "cinematic wedding videographer" portfolios actually show.
resources.li_text.cleanup.51169298: Cleanup. AI removes grain, tape hiss, and tracking artifacts. We do this carefully — over-cleaned video looks fake.
resources.li_text.color_grading_as_a_sep: "Color grading as a separate line item." Good color grading should be included in the editing cost. If they're charging extra, ask why.
resources.li_text.color_grading_look_at_: Color grading. Look at skin tones — if they look orange or green, the editor is bad.
resources.li_text.color_restoration.9464: Color restoration. The hardest part. AI does the heavy lifting (auto color, white balance) but a human editor makes the final calls. A 1985 magenta-faded wedding is not the same as a 1990 yellow-faded one.
resources.li_text.coverage_variety_a_gre: Coverage variety. A great wedding video has wide shots, close-ups, and detail shots. Not just one angle.
resources.li_text.create_a_best_of_highl: Create a "best of" highlight reel for Instagram. 30-60 seconds, vertical, captioned. Pin it to your profile for the first year of marriage.
resources.li_text.create_a_private_youtu: Create a private YouTube channel for your family. Upload the full wedding video + the highlight reel + the trailers. Share the link with everyone who was there. They'll re-share it for years.
resources.li_text.create_a_thank_you_mes: Create a thank-you message for guests. Use the best moments from each table/table-group into a 2-minute "thank you" video. Send it as a private YouTube link with a personal message.
resources.li_text.day_of_shoot_40_50.638: Day-of shoot (40-50%): The videographer(s) on site. 8-12 hours at $50-$300/hour per shooter.
resources.li_text.digitization.07243523: Digitization. We use professional-grade VCRs (not consumer ones) with time-base correctors. The output is a clean digital file at 720x480.
resources.li_text.do_you_mic_the_groom.9: "Do you mic the groom?" — Wireless lapel mic on the groom is non-negotiable. If they don't, skip.
resources.li_text.do_you_use_the_same_mu: "Do you use the same music as the venue's DJ?" — If yes, ask who pays the licensing fee. Surprise: usually you do.
resources.li_text.documentary_3_6_hours_: Documentary (3-6 hours, full ceremony + reception): Traditional wedding videography. Coverage of the day, edited into a long-form film. Most "wedding videographers" do this.
resources.li_text.drone_footage.22660809: Drone footage. Beautiful but rarely essential. Most venues have aerial shots in their marketing already.
resources.li_text.drone_work_is_extra_at: Drone work is "extra" at most companies. A 30-second drone shot adds $300-$500 to your bill. Worth asking if it's included.
resources.li_text.equipment_amortization: Equipment amortization (5-10%): Cameras, lenses, gimbals, audio gear, drones. Pro gear costs $20K+ and depreciates over 3-5 years.
resources.li_text.footage_that_was_recor: Footage that was recorded over. If your dad taped Monday Night Football over your parents' wedding, that footage is gone.
resources.li_text.highlight_reel_3_7_min: Highlight reel (3-7 minutes): A short film of the best moments, set to music. The most popular style now.
resources.li_text.how_many_weddings_have: "How many weddings have you shot solo?" — 50+ minimum. If less, ask who's their backup.
resources.li_text.hybrid.90489347: Hybrid: A short trailer + a longer full ceremony film. Best of both worlds.
resources.li_text.i_ll_send_you_the_raw_: "I'll send you the raw footage for free." Translation: they're not editing it, and you don't have the software/skill to either.
resources.li_text.is_drone_footage_inclu: "Is drone footage included, and is it licensed?" — Drone work requires a Part 107 license. No license = illegal flight = risk of shutdown mid-shot.
resources.li_text.make_20_30_gifs_and_me: Make 20-30 GIFs and memes for the group chat. Aunt Linda's shocked face, the best man's reaction, your dad's dance moves. Send them to the family group chat on a slow Tuesday. You'll become the family legend.
resources.li_text.make_a_30_second_loop_: Make a 30-second loop of your vows. Just the audio. The visual is a single still from the moment. Set it as a phone wallpaper. Every time you unlock your phone, you remember why you married this person.
resources.li_text.make_a_5_minute_greate: Make a 5-minute "greatest hits" for your home TV. Loop it on a screensaver or smart display. Every dinner party, the video plays in the background.
resources.li_text.make_a_first_dance_onl: Make a "first dance" only version. Just the song, the dance, the reactions. 3-4 minutes. Send it to the people on the dance floor — they didn't get to see themselves from the outside.
resources.li_text.make_the_1987_style_vh: Make the 1987-style VHS "playable." Some families have older relatives who won't navigate a streaming service. Burn the highlight reel to a USB stick and put it in a box that looks like a vintage tape. They get to feel like it's 1987 again.
resources.li_text.minidv_hi8_1995_2010.6: MiniDV / Hi8 (1995-2010): Best case. Digital format means less degradation. Just needs transfer and light color correction.
resources.li_text.mold_eaten_or_physical: Mold-eaten or physically shredded tape. If the magnetic tape is physically destroyed, no software can save it.
resources.li_text.music_licensing_5_10.6: Music licensing (5-10%): Premium music costs $50-$500 per song. Lots of videographers use YouTube-free music that's actually infringing (you'll get muted on social media).
resources.li_text.music_rights_don_t_tra: Music rights don't transfer. If the music in your wedding video is licensed to the videographer (most professional music is), you can't use the video commercially without re-licensing. "Personal use" is fine, but you can't put it on a venue's website, sell it, or use it in ads.
resources.li_text.one_year_anniversary_p: One year anniversary post. Pull one still frame from the best moment, share it on your anniversary every year. People will look forward to it.
resources.li_text.output.21536691: Output. 1080p MP4 by default. 4K available. Original digital file archived for 30 days.
resources.li_text.pay_50_upfront_50_on_d: "Pay 50% upfront, 50% on delivery" — standard. Anything more aggressive (like 100% upfront) is risky.
resources.li_text.post_a_15_second_verti: Post a 15-second vertical "first look" reveal. TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts. The single best-performing format for wedding content.
resources.li_text.post_a_behind_the_scen: Post a "behind the scenes" reel. The videographer's BTS footage, the getting-ready moments, the candid reactions. More authentic than the polished edit.
Post-production (30-40%): The editing. 30-80 hours of work for a 5-minute highlight reel. This is where the actual value is — and where cheap videographers cut corners.
resources.li_text.pre_production_5_10_of: Pre-production (5-10% of cost): Pre-wedding calls, venue visit, shot list. Often skipped by lower-tier videographers.
resources.li_text.prices_way_below_marke: Prices way below market for your area — either they're inexperienced, they're about to go out of business, or there are hidden fees.
Prices way below market (under $1,500 for full day). Either they're inexperienced, or there's a hidden cost.
resources.li_text.print_a_30_page_photo_: Print a 30-page photo book with QR codes to video moments. At each photo, add a QR code linking to the corresponding video moment. The book is the index; the video is the experience.
resources.li_text.professional_ai_restor: Professional AI restoration: $200-$500 per tape. The right answer for most families.
resources.li_text.raw_footage_isn_t_actu: "Raw footage" isn't actually free. If your videographer gives you the "raw files" (un-edited), you need a 4TB external drive ($80) and a computer that can edit 4K video ($2,000+). Otherwise, you can't open them.
resources.li_text.same_day_edit.57561765: Same-day edit. Impressive but the video still exists 5 years from now. The "wow factor" of seeing it at the reception is short-lived.
resources.li_text.same_day_edit_is_a_1_0: "Same-day edit" is a $1,000+ upsell. The videographer who stays an extra 4 hours after the wedding to edit a 3-minute teaser for the reception. Impressive but expensive.
resources.li_text.second_shooter.9426517: Second shooter. A single great shooter beats two mediocre ones. If the price forces a choice, pick the better solo videographer.
resources.li_text.send_a_30_second_trail: Send a 30-second trailer to the people who couldn't come. A 30-second vertical video is the right length to text to cousins who live abroad. They get to feel included without sitting through a 10-minute film.
resources.li_text.severely_water_damaged: Severely water-damaged footage. After 24-48 hours underwater, recovery requires specialized (expensive) clean-room services.
resources.li_text.stabilization_shaky_fo: Stabilization. Shaky footage = inexperienced shooter. Gimbal or Steadicam is the standard now.
resources.li_text.starting_at_500_usuall: "Starting at $500" — usually means $500 for a 3-minute highlight with no audio polish.
resources.li_text.the_4k_deliverable.879: The 4K deliverable. 1080p is fine for 99% of viewing contexts. You don't need 4K unless you're projecting on a wall.
resources.li_text.they_film_with_one_cam: They film with one camera, no audio plan. A single shooter with no audio backup is gambling with your only record of the day.
resources.li_text.they_won_t_give_you_re: They won't give you references. Or they give you only friends.
resources.li_text.travel_fees_for_destin: Travel fees for destination weddings. Standard. Just confirm the cost upfront.
resources.li_text.upscaling.03585765: Upscaling. Topaz Video Enhance AI or similar tools upscale 480p to 1080p or 4K. This is where modern AI really shines.
resources.li_text.use_a_still_as_your_ho: Use a still as your holiday card photo. One frame from the video, professionally printed. More personal than a posed shot.
resources.li_text.vhs_to_digital_just_di: VHS to digital (just digitization, no restoration): $25-$50 per tape at a local service. Quality varies wildly.
resources.li_text.vhs_vhs_c_1976_2005.74: VHS / VHS-C (1976-2005): Highly recoverable. AI upscaling from 480p to 1080p is excellent. Color restoration is solid. The biggest issue is tracking errors and tape damage — usually fixable.
resources.li_text.vhs_with_major_trackin: VHS with major tracking errors throughout. Some tapes are so worn that the playback is unwatchable — and the original signal is unrecoverable.
resources.li_text.what_happens_if_your_c: "What happens if your camera fails mid-ceremony?" — They should have a backup camera on standby. Most pros do.
resources.li_text.what_s_included_in_the: "What's included in the package, exactly?" — Get a line-item list. Hours of coverage, number of videographers, delivery format, music licensing.
resources.li_text.when_do_i_get_the_fina: "When do I get the final video, and what's the revision policy?" — Industry standard: 8-12 weeks delivery, 1-2 revision rounds included.
resources.li_text.you_didn_t_hire_a_vide: You didn't hire a videographer and have a collection of photos + guest phone footage
resources.li_text.you_have_a_3_000_budge: You have a $3,000+ budget and care about the result 10+ years from now
resources.li_text.you_have_old_footage_t: You have old footage that needs restoration (VHS, 8mm, 16mm)
resources.li_text.you_have_raw_footage_t: You have raw footage that wasn't edited well and want a professional cut
resources.li_text.you_need_multilingual_: You need multilingual versions for international family
resources.li_text.you_want_a_creative_re: You want a creative reinterpretation (Ghibli style, Pixar style, etc.)
resources.li_text.you_want_a_real_human_: You want a real human making creative decisions on the day
resources.li_text.you_want_consistent_sh: You want consistent shot quality throughout the day
resources.li_text.your_venue_has_tricky_: Your venue has tricky lighting (dark churches, mixed indoor/outdoor)
